summary: Digit iterators incorrectly delegated bulk reads using the underlying Bytes contiguity flag. A format permitting exponent separators makes Bytes noncontiguous even when its integer iterator is contiguous, causing a debug assertion during parsing of "31.01e7_1". The fix passes the digit iterator's own contiguity flag. Reverse only that bulk-read delegation. The existing test is a top-level function in lexical-parse-float/tests/api_tests.rs; select package lexical-parse-float, test target api_tests, with format enabled, compact disabled, and debug assertions enabled. No tests were added by this fix. This plan has not been executed.
